verdict.rationale: The Minnesota SOS business and liens portal offers search, filing, ordering copies, data subscriptions, and a 90-day transaction history. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from a user's data. The Revenue site's "news and insights straight to your inbox" is an email newsletter, not an in-product AI capability, so it earns no credit. Because an online government service portal could plausibly offer such features, the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
